column1: # Every function of the node source that calls a sink (rule E2 of the egress policy,
# docs/egress-policy.md). `scripts/secret-access.sh --check` compares the first four columns
# with the source and fails when a call is missing here or no longer exists.
# Columns, separated by tabs: sink, file, function, calls, note (what holds at that call).
# K1 record::seal, K2 seal_transfer, K3 send_to_provider, K4 hand_out, K5 send_to_log_store,
# K6 imap, K7 smtp, K8 seal_secret_use, K9 send_to_bound_host.

column5: the plaintext is an OauthPlaintext: a token response the node received, an opened record, or the merge rules applied to those. The record keeps the kind the plaintext came from

the plaintext is an OperatorValue: a value the caller of vault/store gave, with the name, the sites and the slots of that call, and the source operator. The id and the nonce of the record are node randomness, and the record leaves after the log store confirmed the entry of its event connection_created

the peer is a Peer, which only verify_peer creates: the same platform and the same log store, and on nitro the same measurement or, under an endorsement that passed the six checks of protocol.md 10.3, the measurement and the release of the statement of a later release. A transfer to a node of the same measurement has no entry: the user key moves between two instances of one program. For a peer of a later release the entry grant_transferred_out that names this peer, its release and its measurement exists for every account of the transfer before, and the log store confirmed it: this call created it, or an earlier transfer of the same grant to the same peer did
the one call of the node to the sealing function of the protocol crate: the keys it seals to are those of the verified peer

the destination is an address that passed check_address of the provider definition. The entry that holds the event provider_request of the request is on the chain before and the log store confirmed it: the event of this request, or the event of an identical GET without a body of the last 300 seconds that the request shares. forward calls it once; forward/batch calls it once per request of the batch, at most 6 at a time, after one commit confirmed the entries of all of them

the destination is an address that passed check_address of the provider definition. The entry that holds the event provider_request of the request is on the chain before and the log store confirmed it, as for execute. forward calls it once, for a call that asked for its response as a stream
the destination is the revocation address of the provider definition. The entry connection_removed is on the chain before, and the log store confirmed it

the destination is the token address of the provider definition. A refresh has its entry credential_refreshed on the chain before, and the log store confirmed it. An exchange has no entry yet: its entry connection_created is confirmed before the record leaves
the record is a vault record and the field is one of its kind. The entry secret_released or totp_issued is on the chain before, and the log store confirmed it

what is written is an entry the node created and signed: its content is sealed to the log public key of the account. The destination is the bucket of the account among the buckets of the log store of the operator configuration, which the binding of the attestation names. The credentials are those the operator domain gave

what is written is the node document: the attestation document of the platform over the binding of the node, which holds public values only. The destination is the bucket of the node among the buckets of the same log store, and the credentials are those the operator domain gave
verifies IMAP after the log store confirmed the attempted use
reads through the authenticated IMAP session after logging
verifies SMTP without sending a message after logging
submits one reviewed message after logging
the one call of the node to the sealing function of the protocol crate: the keys it seals to are those of the verified node of the forward role

the node is a ForwardNode, which only ForwardNodes::verify creates: a node of the platform and the measurement of this node whose binding names the role forward. The request is one the reach of the record admits: its host is one of the sites and its slot one of the slots. The entry that holds the event provider_request of the use is on the chain before, and the log store confirmed it

the request is a BoundRequest, which only BoundRequest::build creates, from an opened envelope: sealed to this node, signed by the node it names and within its time. Its number was marked as used right before, so one envelope sends one request. The host, the method, the address and the body are those of the envelope, and the value stands at its slot and nowhere else
